next_steps_for_deployment: 1. Schema Migration: Execute PostgreSQL schema creation scripts (Database/Scripts/01_InitialSetup.sql equivalent for PostgreSQL)
2. Update Connection Strings: Replace placeholder passwords with actual PostgreSQL credentials
3. Database Connectivity Testing: Verify application can connect to PostgreSQL database
4. Unit Testing: Execute all unit tests against PostgreSQL database
5. Integration Testing: Perform end-to-end testing of all CRUD operations
6. Performance Testing: Compare query execution times between SQL Server and PostgreSQL
7. Data Migration: Migrate existing data from SQL Server to PostgreSQL (if applicable)
8. UAT: User acceptance testing in PostgreSQL environment
9. Security Review: Verify credential management and connection security
10. Production Deployment: Deploy to production after successful testing
